fusions.name: Barb Torn Free
fusions.desc: Tears the barb loose, dealing 16 damage and leaving the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Snagged
fusions.desc: Flicks a barbed point at a target up to 5 tiles away for 4 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach, and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Line of Barbs
fusions.desc: Casts a barbed line ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward and leaves them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Snag and Draw
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, 15% of the damage you deal heals you for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
